title: CCX / Redis & Valkey
description: CCX Redis/Valkey datastores (redis_exporter via cmon service discovery): health, replication, memory, keyspace, commands, network and persistence. Sentinel metrics are not exported on CCX, so there is no Sentinel row.

panels.title: Node status
panels.description: redis_up per Redis/Valkey node: UP when the exporter can reach the server; click a node for host metrics.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Seconds since the Redis/Valkey server process started (redis_uptime_in_seconds).

panels.title: Ops/s
panels.description: Commands processed per second per node (rate of redis_commands_processed_total).

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: One row per node: datastore, IP, role, Valkey/Redis version and eviction policy (redis_instance_info).

targets.expr: max by (ClusterType, DatastoreName, ip, instance, job, role, redis_version, valkey_version, maxmemory_policy) (redis_instance_info{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Clients
panels.description: Connected and blocked clients per node (redis_connected_clients, redis_blocked_clients).

panels.title: Replica link to master
panels.description: redis_master_link_up on replicas: UP when the replica is connected to its master (primaries show nothing).

panels.title: Connected replicas
panels.description: Replicas attached to each primary (redis_connected_slaves).

panels.title: Seconds since last master I/O
panels.description: redis_master_last_io_seconds_ago on replicas: time since the last interaction with the master.

panels.title: Replica lag (seconds)
panels.description: Lag reported by the primary for each replica (redis_connected_slave_lag_seconds).

panels.title: Replica offset behind master (bytes)
panels.description: Bytes each replica is behind, computed on the primary from one INFO snapshot: master_repl_offset minus the replica's acknowledged offset (redis_connected_slave_offset_bytes). Replicas acknowledge about once per second, so a few hundred bytes are normal; the primary must be among the selected instances.

targets.expr: clamp_min(max by (ClusterName, DatastoreName, ip, instance, job) (redis_master_repl_offset{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"} and on (instance) redis_instance_info{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance",role="master"}) - on (instance) group_right () max by (ClusterName, DatastoreName, ip, instance, job, slave_ip, slave_port, slave_state) (redis_connected_slave_offset_bytes{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"}), 0)

panels.title: Memory used / RSS / peak
panels.description: Memory allocated by Redis (used), resident set size from the OS (RSS) and peak used memory, per node.

panels.title: Memory used of maxmemory
panels.description: Used memory as a share of maxmemory; only nodes with a maxmemory limit (> 0) are shown, nodes without a limit appear in the maxmemory panel as "no limit".

targets.expr: max by (DatastoreName, ip, instance, job) (redis_memory_used_bytes{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"}) / on (instance) group_left () (max by (instance) (redis_memory_max_bytes{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"}) > 0)

panels.title: maxmemory
panels.description: Configured maxmemory per node (redis_memory_max_bytes); 0 means no limit.

panels.title: Fragmentation ratio
panels.description: RSS / used memory (redis_mem_fragmentation_ratio); above ~1.5 indicates fragmentation, below 1 indicates swapping.

panels.title: Fragmentation ratio over time
panels.description: redis_mem_fragmentation_ratio per node over time.

panels.title: Memory breakdown
panels.description: Dataset vs overhead memory and replication backlog per node.

panels.title: Keys per DB
panels.description: Total and expiring keys per logical database (redis_db_keys, redis_db_keys_expiring).

panels.title: Keyspace hit ratio
panels.description: Share of key lookups that found a key: rate(hits) / (rate(hits) + rate(misses)); gaps mean no lookups in the interval.

targets.expr: sum by (DatastoreName, ip, instance, job) (rate(redis_keyspace_hits_total{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (DatastoreName, ip, instance, job) (rate(redis_keyspace_hits_total{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (DatastoreName, ip, instance, job) (rate(redis_keyspace_misses_total{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Hits / misses per second
panels.description: Key lookups per second that hit or missed (rate of redis_keyspace_hits_total / misses_total).

panels.title: Expired / evicted keys
panels.description: Keys removed per second by TTL expiry and by maxmemory eviction (rate of redis_expired_keys_total / redis_evicted_keys_total).

panels.title: Top 10 commands by rate
panels.description: The ten busiest commands across the selected nodes (rate of redis_commands_total by cmd).

panels.title: Average latency per command (top 10)
panels.description: Average server-side execution time per call: rate(redis_commands_duration_seconds_total) / rate(redis_commands_total), slowest ten commands.

panels.title: p99 latency per command (top 10)
panels.description: Server-reported p99 latency per command (redis_latency_percentiles_usec, quantile 99), highest ten.

panels.title: Failed / rejected calls & errors
panels.description: Failed and rejected command calls and error replies per second.

panels.title: Network traffic
panels.description: Bytes per second received and sent by the server, excluding and including replication traffic.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: New connections accepted and rejected (maxclients reached) per second.

panels.title: Time since last RDB save
panels.description: Age of the last successful RDB snapshot: time() - redis_rdb_last_save_timestamp_seconds.

panels.title: Last bgsave status
panels.description: Result of the last RDB background save (redis_rdb_last_bgsave_status).

panels.title: AOF
panels.description: Whether append-only file persistence is enabled (redis_aof_enabled) on each node.

panels.title: AOF last write status
panels.description: Result of the last AOF write (redis_aof_last_write_status).

panels.title: Changes since last RDB save
panels.description: Write operations not yet persisted to an RDB snapshot (redis_rdb_changes_since_last_save).

panels.title: AOF size
panels.description: Current size of the append-only file per node (redis_aof_current_size_bytes).
